market_question: Bitcoin all time high by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: The market implies a 15.5% chance of a new Bitcoin all-time high between mid-December 2025 and end of 2026. While typical post-halving cycles suggest a peak earlier, a 12.5-month window still provides a reasonable opportunity for a new ATH if bullish momentum extends or a new cycle begins earlier than expected. I estimate the true probability closer to 22%, making Yes undervalued.
evidence_points: Bitcoin historically peaks 12-18 months after halving (April 2024), placing a likely peak in early 2025, but cycles can deviate; the window captures a potential early cycle recovery.
A 12.5-month observation period is relatively long, increasing the chance of at least one extreme price spike above prior highs.
Current implied probability of 15.5% appears too low given historical volatility and institutional adoption trends.
